description.ja: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN シリーズに-ACTION-仕様でZEROが登場！
description.en: ZERO is now available in the Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN series with -ACTION- specifications!

description.ja: • 腹部関節は「可動優先時」と「LEDユニット（別売り）内蔵時」の２パターンの選択式。
description.en: • The abdominal joint can be selected from two patterns: "when movable is prioritized " and " when the LED unit (sold separately) is built in".

description.ja: • LEDユニット（別売り）を胸部に収め、胸と目を光らせることができる。
description.en: • An LED unit (sold separately) can be placed in the chest to make the chest and eyes shine.

description.ja: • SUIT Ver7.5の武装（別売り）を装備可能。
description.en: • Can be equipped with SUIT Ver7.5 weapons (sold separately).

description.ja: • プラモデルオリジナル武装「ゼロランス」付属。
description.en: • Includes plastic model original weapon "Zero Lance".

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ（左右）×各２種
accessories.en: Hand parts (left and right) x 2 types each
